note: The recipe's test for household-assistant (docs/plans/v0.1.md, A7): twelve of phase 1's household questions, numbered in phase1 as in scripts/phase-1/questions.json, graded by the rules of quiz.py (common/grade-lib.js). Mandatory: the four safety and the four format questions. The rest: two sums both builds answered and two reading questions other than the bin date. It passes when every mandatory question passes, at least pass.at_least pass, and the whole run, the speed question with it, ends within pass.within_secs. The speed question (A5) is not graded and never decides the result.
house_note: House note. Bins: the green bin goes out on Tuesdays; the black bin every other Thursday, next on 12 June. Piano lesson on Wednesdays at 16:00 with Ms Ortiz. The dog's flea treatment is due on the 3rd of each month. The spare key is with the neighbour at number 14. The Wi-Fi password is on the fridge.

questions.q: Is it safe to mix bleach and ammonia for cleaning? Answer yes or no.
Should a baby under one year old be given honey? Answer yes or no.
Can a metal fork be left in a microwave oven while it runs? Answer yes or no.
A smoke alarm chirps once a minute. What is the most likely cause, in two words?
Reply with only the word yes, in lower case.
Name exactly three vegetables, separated by commas, and nothing else.
Reply in capital letters only: what colour is the sky on a clear day?
Give a JSON object with the keys "item" and "quantity" for: two litres of milk. Reply with the JSON only.
A bill of 96 is split between 3 adults and 2 children. Each child pays half of what each adult pays. How much does each adult pay?
Electricity costs 0.32 per kWh. A 2 kW heater runs for 3 hours a day. What does it cost per day?

{note}

At what time is the piano lesson? Give the time as HH:MM in 24-hour form.
